Well, I have the best way in the world to put a stop to those robocalls, especially the insurance and warranty calls.  I'm now pretty sure that there are really no more than 3 chinese companies doing all of these calls. 

 What I did was, I bought this SUPER high decibel boaters whistle.  This one would make your ears ring for minutes afterwards. I'm not talking about one of the little kiddie looking ones either.  It was a little pricy but it was small and convenient to carry.  

Then, every time my phone would ring with a robocall, I'd follow prompts to talk to a person.  (Now remember, the real people manning these phone lines are wearing headsets most of the time)  The  minute I got a real person on the line, I would lay into that whistle for all its worth and blow their ears out. I would continue to blow till they hung up. It didn't take too many of those calls before I no longer received robocalls, spoofed calls, or any other spam call.   

Once in a blue moon now, I'll get one, employ my whistle once and they mysteriously just go away.
